integrity_notes: Proof and tests use ordinary classical first-order semantics without identity; finite calculations corroborate but do not establish the unrestricted preservation/normal-form impossibility.
scientific_limitations: Preservation under nonempty disjoint unions; no complete classification or minimality of witness size is claimed. Originality may be limited by an unindexed earlier result; the 1985 monograph was not inspected in full.
title: An equality-free one-relation counterexample to a disjoint-union preservation normal form
